description: AICTIONBOT™ Zahlungsschutz by KULIC Advisory. Matches the supplier on an invoice to the vendor master by VAT ID, IBAN and name similarity, validates the IBAN checksum, and flags a changed or unknown bank account, a blocked vendor, a dormant vendor and a first payment. Returns a verdict (stop, check, ok) with the next step. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Findings in German.

invoice.description: supplier (name), vat_id, iban, amount, currency, date (YYYY-MM-DD).

vendor_master.description: Vendor master rows: no (vendor number), name, vat_id, iban, country, last_payment (YYYY-MM-DD or null), blocked (bool).

name: check_invoice_payment
title: Check an invoice against the vendor master before paying: new bank account, unknown supplier, blocked vendor
